title: Meurtres à Sarlat
overview: A female police commander from the city and a male gendarme captain from the sticks join forces to solve the murder of Vincent who was found dead at the Sarlat castle ruins. Vincent just happens to be the son of the richest local businessman! The  the two cops investigating once had a fling togther at a music festival.The murder investigation is the first time they've seen each other since.
